words.word: and according to their appointed time
to every thing there is a season

occurrences.text: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
words: and according to their appointed time

occurrences.text: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
words: To every thing there is a season
